title: At the doctor's
description: Say what hurts, describe symptoms and understand simple advice.

blocks.text: To say what hurts, Polish turns the sentence around: Boli mnie głowa, literally my head hurts me. With a plural noun the verb is plural too: Bolą mnie plecy (my back hurts). Symptoms often use mam: mam gorączkę (I have a fever), mam katar (I have a runny nose). The doctor gives advice with proszę and an infinitive.

blocks.note: Plecy is plural, so the verb is plural: bolą.

blocks.translation: I have a fever and a cough.

blocks.text: Od kiedy pan się źle czuje?
blocks.translation: Since when have you been feeling unwell?
blocks.note: Formal, to a man. To a woman: pani.

blocks.text: Proszę brać ten lek dwa razy dziennie.
blocks.translation: Please take this medicine twice a day.

lines.speaker: Lekarka
lines.translation: What seems to be the problem?

lines.speaker: Pan Jan
lines.text: Boli mnie gardło i mam gorączkę.
lines.translation: I have a sore throat and a fever.

lines.speaker: Lekarka
lines.text: Przepiszę panu lekarstwo. Proszę dużo pić i odpoczywać.
lines.translation: I will prescribe you some medicine. Drink a lot and rest.
